name: Volito intro
description: The Volito intro, 1:1, with its own sound design: a sentence lands word by word, the mark assembles out of its three shapes and blows up into a cobalt field, the extruded wordmark swings in under a light sweep, and the lockup types itself onto paper. Every sound is synthesised by Volito from the same beats.

sentence.label: The sentence
sentence.description: one word or two a line

marked.label: Marked word
marked.description: the word the lime marker swipes under

parts.opening: the whole opening block, which collapses into the mark
parts.sentence: the opening sentence, word by word
parts.marker: the lime marker under the marked word
parts.field: the cobalt field the mark becomes
parts.name: the name in the lockup
